otp_challenges_delivery_state_check.name: otp_challenges_delivery_state_check
otp_challenges_delivery_state_check.value:
(
          "otp_challenges"."delivery_status" = 'pending'
          and "otp_challenges"."delivered_at" is null
          and "otp_challenges"."delivery_failed_at" is null
        ) or (
          "otp_challenges"."delivery_status" = 'delivered'
          and "otp_challenges"."delivered_at" is not null
          and "otp_challenges"."delivery_failed_at" is null
        ) or (
          "otp_challenges"."delivery_status" = 'failed'
          and "otp_challenges"."delivered_at" is null
          and "otp_challenges"."delivery_failed_at" is not null
        )

otp_challenges_consumed_at_order_check.name: otp_challenges_consumed_at_order_check
otp_challenges_consumed_at_order_check.value:
"otp_challenges"."consumed_at" is null
        or (
          "otp_challenges"."consumed_at" >= "otp_challenges"."created_at"
          and "otp_challenges"."verified_at" is not null
          and "otp_challenges"."consumed_at" >= "otp_challenges"."verified_at"
          and (
            ("otp_challenges"."purpose" = 'login'
              and "otp_challenges"."consumed_at" <= "otp_challenges"."expires_at")
            or (
              "otp_challenges"."purpose" = 'registration'
              and "otp_challenges"."verified_at" is not null
              and "otp_challenges"."consumed_at"
                <= "otp_challenges"."verified_at" + interval '15 minutes'
            )
          )
        )

sessions_expiration_order_check.name: sessions_expiration_order_check
sessions_expiration_order_check.value:
"sessions"."expires_at" > "sessions"."created_at"
        and (
          ("sessions"."issued_role" = 'member'
            and "sessions"."expires_at"
              <= "sessions"."created_at" + interval '30 days')
          or (
            "sessions"."issued_role" in ('moderator', 'admin')
            and "sessions"."expires_at"
              <= "sessions"."created_at" + interval '8 hours'
          )
        )

users_suspension_state_check.name: users_suspension_state_check
users_suspension_state_check.value:
("users"."status" = 'active' and "users"."suspended_at" is null)
        or ("users"."status" = 'suspended' and "users"."suspended_at" is not null)

comments_gif_metadata_check.name: comments_gif_metadata_check
comments_gif_metadata_check.value:
("comments"."gif_id" is null
          and "comments"."gif_url" is null
          and "comments"."gif_width" is null
          and "comments"."gif_height" is null
          and "comments"."gif_alt" is null)
        or ("comments"."gif_id" is not null
          and "comments"."gif_url" like 'https://%'
          and "comments"."gif_width" between 1 and 4096
          and "comments"."gif_height" between 1 and 4096
          and char_length(btrim("comments"."gif_alt")) > 0)

media_assets_image_metadata_check.name: media_assets_image_metadata_check
media_assets_image_metadata_check.value:
"media_assets"."mime_type" = 'image/webp'
        and "media_assets"."size_bytes" between 1 and 1048576
        and "media_assets"."width" between 1 and 4096
        and "media_assets"."height" between 1 and 4096
        and "media_assets"."checksum" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

posts_gif_metadata_check.name: posts_gif_metadata_check
posts_gif_metadata_check.value:
("posts"."gif_id" is null
          and "posts"."gif_url" is null
          and "posts"."gif_width" is null
          and "posts"."gif_height" is null
          and "posts"."gif_alt" is null)
        or ("posts"."gif_id" is not null
          and "posts"."gif_url" like 'https://%'
          and "posts"."gif_width" between 1 and 4096
          and "posts"."gif_height" between 1 and 4096
          and char_length(btrim("posts"."gif_alt")) > 0)
